stories.title: Police close Shotton Lane in Ewloe following crash
stories.summary: Shotton Lane in Ewloe is closed after a single vehicle crash. North Wales Police said the road is shut and asked drivers to avoid the area. stories.title: North Wales Police issue warning after fire started in Wepre Park area
stories.summary: Park rangers put out a fire in the Wepre Park area of Connah’s Quay after it smouldered overnight. North Wales Police said the fire was started the previous day and was still burning when it was found the following morning. Rangers reached it before it spread further. stories.title: Man airlifted from Mostyn Docks after coastguard rescue
stories.summary: An injured casualty was airlifted from Mostyn Docks on Sunday afternoon after coastguard teams decided a helicopter was the safest way to get them off the site. stories.title: Mold pupils win £150 for recycled sculpture of town’s Spring Clean mascot
stories.summary: Pupils at a Mold primary school have won £150 after building a sculpture of the town’s Spring Clean mascot entirely out of recycled materials. stories.title: Drivers warned of delays as abnormal load travels through Flintshire
stories.summary: Drivers in Flintshire are being warned of possible delays on Wednesday morning when police escort an abnormal load along the A55, A5119 and A548 to Gronant.
